text:
Rina: starting PayLane LoRA graft into release/1.2.0-serving. scope: merge sanity, nf4-int4 smoke, experimental int3 probe (kv_cache off), and a tiny 26-example quickpack focused on large-amount notation (1e6, 1M, 1,000,000), negative-zero cases, and mixed thousands separators. pinging @Eli for prompt exports.
Eli: on it  I exported PAYLANE_prompts_master.csv (140 rows) and will scrub PII. will produce paylane-quick26.json with 26 cases biased to invoices, scientific notation, SI suffixes (K/M), and some edge bank formats (leading + sign, -0.00).
Marta: FYI I saw a subtle vocab id shift after applying the graft locally: the token for the letter-based suffix "M" in numeric contexts moved and makes "1M" sometimes detokenize with a space: diff sample:
```diff
- token 4021: "M" -> 4021
+ token 4021: "M" -> 4022
```
On short templates that turns "1M" -> "1 M" which breaks downstream parsers.
Omar: customer reported our SDK parser failing on returned amount strings when spacing appears. We should avoid touching base tokenizer. propose: manifest token_remap + a small post-detokenize normalization that collapses number+space+suffix to number+suffix for canonicalization.
Rina: agree. Marta can you draft a manifest remap example and include a note about numeric-suffix mismatch?
Marta: drafting now. prototype manifest snippet I'm testing: ```json
{"model":"paylane-lora-v1","token_remap":{"4022":4021},"notes":"map numeric-suffix M token to original id to avoid space insertion in short templates"}
```
Ken: quant plan: baseline fp16 -> nf4-int4 -> int3 (experimental, kv_cache disabled). Metrics: EM on parsed fields (amount, currency, date), hallucination counts (fabricated or scaled amounts), normalized-number exact-match (after canonicalizer), token-level perplexity, P50/P95 streaming & sync latencies (30-token tail), and cost delta. Add a small regression that checks '1M' vs '1e6' canonicalization parity.
DevBot: CI job queued: run/eng-ml/paylane-smoke/4187654321 (queued). Logs will post here. :robot_face:
DevBot: run/eng-ml/paylane-smoke/4187654321 -> started on a100-55gb. config:
```yaml
model: paylane-lora-v1
base: small-sage-7b
quant: nf4-int4
kv_cache: enabled
batch: 4
max_tokens: 64
evalpack: paylane-quick26.json
```
Eli: uploaded paylane-quick26.json to s3://redwood-evals/paylane/quick26_v1.json and added gold labels plus a small parser to compute normalized-number EM. link: https://s3.redwood/paylane/quick26_v1.json
Ken: int4 first pass (26 examples): EM-fields fp16 0.938 -> int4 0.915, normalized-number EM fp16 0.99 -> int4 0.95, fluency fp16 0.99 -> int4 0.97, P95 latency fp16 205ms -> int4 150ms, cost per token -36%. Observed two cases where "1e6" -> "1000000" but "1M" -> "1 M" (space).
Rina: ok. start int3 but mark experimental. kv_cache: false for int3 per prior stability notes. we care about fabricated magnitude shifts (e.g., 1e3 -> 1e6).
DevBot: run/eng-ml/paylane-smoke/4187654321-int3 -> started (kv_cache: false).
Ken: int3 preliminary (first 8): EM-fields 0.82, normalized-number EM 0.78, fluency 0.89, hallucinations: 2/8 (magnitude jumps), P95 120ms. will run full 26 and post breakdown.
Marta: I pushed a manifest remap to my branch and a tiny unit for canonical detokenize (collapsing number+space+suffix). snippet in PR: ```json
{"token_remap":{"4022":"4021"}}
```
Omar: please also add a serving postprocess that canonicalizes scientific-nota and suffix forms to a single normalized representation before parser runs. add a smoke assertion comparing fp16/int4/int3 normalized-number EM on 12 short templates so product doesn't see spurious diffs.
Eli: quickpack v2 uploaded with 3 adversarial entries (1M with space, 1e6 scientific, -0.00 negative-zero). path: s3://redwood-evals/paylane/quick26_v2.json
Ken: int3 finished (26 examples): EM-fields 0.80, normalized-number EM 0.76, fluency 0.88, hallucinations flagged 5/26 (magnitude or suffix corruption), P95 118ms. Full logs and token-level perplexities at /runs/4187654321/int3/summary.json.
DevBot: run/eng-ml/paylane-smoke/4187654321 -> completed (status: WARN). artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/paylane/4187654321/artifacts.tar.gz
Rina: action items: (1) Eli finalize quick26 with adversarial cases (done), (2) Marta push manifest remap + unit test (wip), (3) Ken attach full artifacts and cost delta sheet, (4) Omar add serving canonicalizer + smoke assertion. If int3 regressions remain high we'll promote int4 and enable a route-level fp16 fallback for payment parsing endpoints.
Ken: I'll also compute expected cost delta and a rough per-request savings number for product.
Omar: adding the canonicalizer PR and smoke assertion now.
Eli: added a synthetic regression test for number-suffix canonicalization tests/evals/number_suffix_norm_paylane.py. will gate canary on that test.
Rina: thanks everyone. I'll bundle the manifest remap, the postprocess canonicalizer, and the smoke CI step into a small PR and hold canary until the number-suffix test passes. closing thread once PRs are green. :white_check_mark:
